goodThing.fits: Tel Aviv: the largest concentration of Bauhaus buildings in the world, a World Heritage Site since 2003.
goodThing.headline: The White City: more Bauhaus than anywhere on earth
goodThing.line: Architects who fled Europe in the 1930s built a city of clean lines and balconies. UNESCO listed it as World Heritage in 2003.

source.name: Tel Aviv-Yafo Municipality: White City Center

funFact.statement: Tel Aviv-Jaffa has more than a hundred kilometres of bike paths.
funFact.reveal: About 190 kilometres, with 300 planned. One in four trips in the city is meant to be on two wheels.

kindness.fits: Tel Aviv, the day before Sukkot: the sukkahs on the balconies.
kindness.text: A neighbour building a sukkah on the balcony or in the yard? Stop for ten minutes and hold a beam. A sukkah built by two stands straighter.
